title: designfuchen/word-atlas
why_read: An illustrated IELTS vocabulary app with spaced-repetition scheduling, useful as a language-learning tool but not a technical engineering project of broad interest.
analysis: Word Atlas combines a large illustrated vocabulary dataset for IELTS preparation with audio pronunciations and FSRS, a modern spaced-repetition scheduling algorithm similar to what's used in Anki. The open-source app plus a Creative-Commons-licensed dataset is a nice contribution for language learners and educators building similar tools. Technically it's a fairly standard app built on an existing spaced-repetition algorithm rather than a novel engineering contribution. Its main value is as a polished end-user application rather than something with transferable engineering lessons.
